protocol.source: Saved complete ROC results only; no model execution or threshold resweep.
protocol.fa: False-positive pixels divided by all test image pixels; fractions, not percentages.
protocol.pd: Detected target components divided by target components; fractions.
protocol.budget_best: Highest Pd among measured points with Fa <= requested budget; may use a lower Fa.
protocol.linear_estimate: Descriptive interpolation only, not a measured point or inferred threshold.
protocol.outside_range: Unavailable at target; no extrapolation or added (0,0)/(1,1) endpoints.
protocol.comparison_limit: Test ROC comparison is retrospective analysis, not independent validation or threshold selection.
